name: 先天性吸収不良症候群（先天性クロール下痢）

summary.text: A rare genetic intestinal disease characterized by persistent, potentially life-threatening, watery diarrhea with excessive levels of chloride in stools, hypochloremia, hyponatremia, hypokalemia, and metabolic alkalosis, resulting in chronic dehydration and failure to thrive. Antenatal ultrasound typically reveals polyhydramnios and significant dilatation of the fetal intestinal loops.
